'''Schloss Adler''' (<mark>schloss.bsp</mark>) is a large 4on4 Team Deathmatch map depicting a gloomy castle. Textures from Return to Castle Wolfenstein are used to create a certain look. Schloss has 8 spawn points and features every major powerup.

==How to Play==
===Spawns / Openers===
Basic openers for every spawn which do not rely on super fast communication or reactions in the first second of the match.

*'''QUAD-LOW'''
:Fastest spawn for [[Pent]], go left through the tunnel and take it. Then take [[Mega]] and [[GL]] if available and go for second [[YA]] and [[RL]] of your choice.

*'''TOWER-ENTRY'''
:Jump left around the corner and check Pent. Usually QUAD-LOW spawn will get it, but you should try! If an enemy got it, take Mega and GL from them. Leave items for team Pent.

*'''QUAD'''
:Fastest spawn for either [[Quad]] or CAT RL. Pick one but do not hesitate or else you will be beaten by either CAT-SSG or QUAD-HIGH spawn.

*'''QUAD-HIGH'''
:Second fastest for Quad. Go left and drop onto it. It is yours if the QUAD spawn went for CAT RL.

*'''CAT-SSG/WINDOW'''
:Second fastest for CAT RL. Go for it. It is yours if the QUAD spawn went for Quad. Take YA after RL.

*'''TOWER'''
:Take RL, take YA. CEMETARY-TELE spawn might teleport and steal YA while you take RL. If so, teleport yourself and see if CEMETARY MEGA, [[Ring]] or [[RA]] are still up.

*'''CEMETARY-TELE'''
:You can be first to either RA, Ring or Mega. Grab as many as your movement ability allows you to and in whatever order you please. You will be faster than the CEMETARY spawn for at least your first item.

*'''CEMETARY'''
:See what CEMETARY-TELE goes for and grab what is left. e.g. If they go for RA first, you go for Ring and Mega.
